rows: Your own pentest and audit boutique
You set the price per engagement, add clients through referrals, and later hire testers or package repeat work such as a yearly retest.
Not a starter route. Clients need to trust you with their systems, so it comes after a track record, a sample report and a few referrals.
Teaching what you can really do reaches many learners at once through batches, courses or corporate workshops.
Needs real field work first. Teaching with no practice behind it is the exact thing that feeds the course scams below.
A deep, small field. Very few roles, strong competition at the entry stage and a second, harder stage to reach senior research work.
Treat it as a later specialisation after years in pentesting, not as a first goal.

items.text: Duplicate-prone bug bounty hunting on large, well-known programs where many people and tools look at the same targets.
